biggest_catch: The cap is only $100 (four referrals) — one of the smallest caps in this lane.
catches: To qualify, your friend/family member must not have a checking account with ACNB currently.
The referred customer's account must be in good standing to receive the $25 cash credit.
Each $25 gift may be subject to IRS Form 1099 reporting.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: ACNB Bank's official Refer a Friend page (acnb.com/refer) pays the referrer $25 for each friend who opens a qualifying personal checking account.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: $25 for each referral, up to $100 (four referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: invite friends to open a checking account online at acnb.com/checking using the code REFER25 in the promo box; or they mention your name and phone number when opening at an office; or print/share referral cards.

c4.evidence: Timing: once the new qualifying personal account is opened, $25 will be deposited into the referrer's account (or provided as an official check if the referrer has no transaction account).

eligibility: ACNB Bank customers referring friends or family who open a qualifying personal checking account (Basic, Advantage Rewards, or Advantage Rewards Checking Plus).
notes: ACNB Bank (Gettysburg, PA; 29 locations in MD/PA; NWSB and FCB are divisions). Distinct from R0536's $2000 earn2000 signup bonus.
payout_quote: Spread the word and invite your friends and family to open a qualifying personal checking account and receive $25 for each referral. Earn up to $100! To qualify for the $25 gift, your friend/family member must not have a checking account with us currently. Once their new qualifying personal account is opened, $25 will be deposited in your account.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Each $25 gift may be subject to IRS Form 1099 reporting.

s5.note: Program live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); no expiration date listed.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: friends open online with code REFER25 in the promo box, mention you at an office, or use a printed referral card.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: open a new qualifying personal checking account (must not currently have a checking account with ACNB); the account must be in good standing.

steps: Invite friends to open an ACNB personal checking account online with code REFER25 in the promo box (or mention your name and phone number at an office).
Once their new qualifying personal account is opened, $25 is deposited into your account.
timing: $25 deposited into the referrer's account once the friend's new qualifying personal account is opened.
